description: Keyword sequence rules to enforce domain constraints
comment: Add your rules below. See KEYWORD_RULES.md for documentation.

required_following.comment: Keywords that MUST follow a given keyword. Example: 'login1.login_user': ['login1.authenticate']

preferred_following.comment: Keywords that should be boosted in probability. Example: 'login1.authenticate': ['login1.verify_session']

blocked_following.comment: Keywords that should NEVER follow a given keyword. Example: 'login1.logout': ['login1.login_user']
